section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)

content.description: Illustration showing SST (Special Service Tool) being used to compress return springs on spring retainer, with a snap ring shown separately

items: INSTALL TWELVE PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND SET RETAINER WITH SNAP RING IN PLACE
COMPRESS RETURN SPRINGS AND INSTALL SNAP RING IN GROOVE
(a) Place SST on the spring retainer, and compress the springs on a shop press.
(b) Install the snap ring using a screwdriver.

content.description: Illustration showing center support assembly with O-rings installed on piston

items: INSTALL NEW O-RINGS ON PISTON AND CENTER SUPPORT
TURN CENTER SUPPORT OVER AND INSTALL NO. 2 BRAKE PISTON

content.text: Press the No. 2 brake piston into the center support with the cup side up, being careful not to damage the O-rings.

content.description: Illustration showing SST compressing return springs with snap ring shown separately, similar to first diagram

items: INSTALL TWENTY PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND SET RETAINER WITH SNAP RING IN PLACE
COMPRESS RETURN SPRINGS AND INSTALL SNAP RING IN GROOVE
(a) Place SST on the spring retainer, and compress the springs on a shop press.
(b) Install the snap ring with a screwdriver.

content.description: Illustration showing brake plate installation with arrows indicating downward direction and rounded edge orientation

items: TURN CENTER SUPPORT OVER AND INSTALL NO. 1 BRAKE PISTON PLATE, DISC AND FLANGE

content.text: Using the low-pressure compressed air, blow all excess ATF from the disc.
CAUTION: High-pressure air will damage the disc.
Install in order: Plate-disc-plate-plate-disc-flange (rounded edge down)

items: INSTALL SNAP RING IN CENTER SUPPORT

content.text: Check that snap ring ends are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of piston stroke using a dial indicator on the center support assembly

items: CHECK PISTON STROKE OF NO. 1 BRAKE

content.text: With a dial indicator, measure the stroke applying and releasing the compressed air (4 — 8 kg/cm², 57 — 114 psi or 392 — 785 kPa).
If the stroke exceeds the limit, the clutch pack is probably worn. If the stroke is less than the limit, parts may be mis-assembled or there may be excess ATF on the discs.
